samples.title: Chọn quà cho bạn đi Mỹ một năm
samples.focus: A farewell present for a year abroad
samples.prompt: A friend will spend a year in the USA. Choose a farewell gift from the three options and explain your decision.
requirementsVi: Chọn một trong ba món quà và giải thích.
So sánh với cả hai món còn lại.

paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose a scarf. I would assume that my friend already has a phone with a camera and will experience some cold weather during the year. If those assumptions were wrong, I might choose differently, but a scarf would be my first choice.

samples.title: Đi từ Đà Nẵng ra Hà Nội bằng gì?

Nêu lợi thế và lý do không ưu tiên hai phương tiện khác.

paragraphs.label: Lựa chọn
paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose a plane. The question does not give a budget or a travel schedule, so I would base my choice on a group that wants to spend more time in Hanoi and can afford suitable tickets.

samples.prompt: Your younger brother is moving away for college and cannot cook. He has four weekends to learn basic meals and needs someone to correct his mistakes. Recommend one of the three learning methods.
requirementsVi: Ưu tiên người hướng dẫn sửa lỗi trực tiếp.

They could also teach him how to plan a small shopping list and store leftovers safely.

samples.title: Chọn đồ cải thiện phòng ngủ nhỏ
samples.focus: Organising study materials in limited space
samples.prompt: Your bedroom is small, and books and study notes are spread across the floor. You can afford only one new item. Choose the purchase that would improve your study space most.
requirementsVi: Vấn đề chính là đồ học không có chỗ để.
Chọn một món, giải thích tác dụng trong phòng nhỏ.
Không tự thêm nhu cầu giải trí làm trọng tâm.
samples.summaryVi: Vấn đề chính là đồ học không có chỗ để. → Chọn một món, giải thích tác dụng trong phòng nhỏ. → Không tự thêm nhu cầu giải trí làm trọng tâm.

paragraphs.label: Lựa chọn
paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose a tall bookcase. The problem is not simply that the room looks plain; books and notes are taking up the floor. A bookcase would deal directly with that problem while using vertical space.
paragraphs.noteVi: Ưu tiên đúng vấn đề được mô tả.

parts.text: For this situation, I would choose
parts.labelVi: Chọn một phương án + cụm danh từ

parts.text: a tall bookcase. The problem is not simply that the room looks plain; books and notes are taking up the floor. A bookcase would deal directly with that problem while using vertical space.

paragraphs.label: Lý do cụ thể
paragraphs.text: I could organise textbooks by subject and keep loose notes in labelled folders. That would make it easier to find the material I need before each study session. Clearing the floor would also make moving around the room more comfortable. Before buying, I would measure the available space and check that the bookcase could be installed securely.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích cơ chế và một bước kiểm tra khả thi.

parts.text: I could organise textbooks by subject and keep loose notes in labelled folders. That would make it easier to find the material I need before each study session. Clearing the floor would also make moving around the room more comfortable. Before buying, I would measure the available space and check that the bookcase could be installed securely.

paragraphs.label: So sánh
paragraphs.text: A larger desk might provide more writing space, but in a small bedroom it could make the room feel crowded. Without storage, the desk might soon be covered in the same piles of books. A decorative lamp would make the room look nicer and might improve lighting, but the question does not suggest that poor lighting is the main difficulty. It would leave the clutter largely unchanged.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không chọn đèn chỉ vì mọi phòng đều cần ánh sáng.

It would leave the clutter largely unchanged.

paragraphs.label: Kết
paragraphs.text: For these reasons, I would spend the money on storage first. Once the books had a proper place, I could see whether any further changes to the study area were really necessary.
paragraphs.noteVi: Một quyết định rõ, không mua cả ba.

samples.title: Chọn cách giúp sinh viên mới hòa nhập
samples.focus: A newcomer who feels nervous in large groups
samples.prompt: A new international student feels lonely and is nervous in large groups. Your class wants to help the student settle in. Which of the three approaches would you choose?
requirementsVi: Tính đến sự lo lắng khi ở nhóm đông.
Nêu cách giúp hòa nhập lâu hơn một lần gặp.
Không gán quốc tịch hoặc khả năng ngôn ngữ chưa được đề cho.
samples.summaryVi: Tính đến sự lo lắng khi ở nhóm đông. → Nêu cách giúp hòa nhập lâu hơn một lần gặp. → Không gán quốc tịch hoặc khả năng ngôn ngữ chưa được đề cho.

paragraphs.label: Chọn cách
paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose a buddy arrangement with one classmate. The student is nervous in large groups, so a single friendly contact would probably feel more manageable than meeting many people at once.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không tự kết luận người nước ngoài nào cũng nhút nhát.

parts.text: For this situation, I would choose
parts.labelVi: Chọn một phương án + cụm danh từ

parts.text: a buddy arrangement with one classmate. The student is nervous in large groups, so a single friendly contact would probably feel more manageable than meeting many people at once.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích
paragraphs.text: The buddy could sit with the student in class, explain everyday arrangements and invite them to have lunch. This would create repeated opportunities to talk without putting the student at the centre of attention. Over time, the buddy could introduce one or two more classmates. I would ask the student what kind of help they wanted, rather than assume that we should organise every part of their day.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỗ trợ đều và tôn trọng lựa chọn cá nhân.

parts.text: The buddy could sit with the student in class, explain everyday arrangements and invite them to have lunch. This would create repeated opportunities to talk without putting the student at the centre of attention. Over time, the buddy could introduce one or two more classmates. I would ask the student what kind of help they wanted, rather than assume that we should organise every part of their day.

paragraphs.label: So sánh
paragraphs.text: A large welcome party might be enjoyable for some newcomers, but it could increase this student’s anxiety and make conversation difficult. Sending a list of university clubs would provide useful information, yet it would still leave the student to make the first contact alone. Club information could support the buddy arrangement later, once the student felt more comfortable.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không chỉ loại bỏ, có thể dùng phương án phụ sau.

parts.text: A large welcome party might be enjoyable for some newcomers, but it could increase this student’s anxiety and make conversation difficult. Sending a list of university clubs would provide useful information, yet it would still leave the student to make the first contact alone. Club information could support the buddy arrangement later, once the student felt more comfortable.

paragraphs.label: Chốt
paragraphs.text: Overall, a buddy would offer the gentlest start and practical support over several days. I would choose someone patient and available, and check after a week whether the arrangement was helping.
paragraphs.noteVi: Có cách theo dõi mức phù hợp.

samples.title: Chọn việc làm thêm khi có lịch học cố định
samples.focus: Earning money while protecting study time
samples.prompt: You study from Monday to Friday and need a part-time job. You can work weekends, want reliable pay and have no vehicle. Consider the three advertised jobs and choose the best fit.
requirementsVi: Cân nhắc lịch học, thu nhập và việc không có xe.
Dùng đúng thông tin quảng cáo trong các lựa chọn.
Không chọn chỉ vì công việc nghe thú vị.
samples.summaryVi: Cân nhắc lịch học, thu nhập và việc không có xe. → Dùng đúng thông tin quảng cáo trong các lựa chọn. → Không chọn chỉ vì công việc nghe thú vị.

paragraphs.label: Lựa chọn
paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose the weekend bookshop assistant job near my home. It fits the days when I am free, offers a fixed hourly wage and does not require me to own a vehicle.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đáp ứng cùng lúc ba điều kiện.

parts.text: For this situation, I would choose
parts.labelVi: Chọn một phương án + cụm danh từ

parts.text: the weekend bookshop assistant job near my home. It fits the days when I am free, offers a fixed hourly wage and does not require me to own a vehicle.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích thực tế
paragraphs.text: The main reason is that a predictable schedule would help me protect my study time during the week. Being close to home would also reduce travel costs and make it easier to arrive on time. I could build customer service experience while knowing roughly how much I would earn each month. I would confirm the exact weekend hours before accepting, especially during exam periods.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không tự hứa có thể đổi lịch; cần hỏi trước.

parts.text: The main reason is that

I could build customer service experience while knowing roughly how much I would earn each month. I would confirm the exact weekend hours before accepting, especially during exam periods.

paragraphs.label: So sánh công việc khác
paragraphs.text: The delivery job might offer flexible hours, but the advertisement requires a motorbike. Since I do not have one, renting or buying a vehicle would create an extra cost. The weekday café job would provide regular pay, but its afternoon shifts would clash with my classes. Missing lessons to work would undermine the reason I need a manageable part-time job in the first place.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua điều kiện cứng về xe và ca làm.

samples.title: Chọn bước giảm rác ở câu lạc bộ
samples.focus: A modest budget and waste from weekly meetings
samples.prompt: Your club meets weekly in the same room. Most of its rubbish is disposable cups and bottled water. With a small budget, choose the action that would reduce this waste most directly.
requirementsVi: Đúng loại rác: cốc dùng một lần và chai nước.
Ưu tiên giảm rác tại nguồn với ngân sách nhỏ.
Không mặc định thùng tái chế tự làm giảm lượng rác phát sinh.
samples.summaryVi: Đúng loại rác: cốc dùng một lần và chai nước. → Ưu tiên giảm rác tại nguồn với ngân sách nhỏ. → Không mặc định thùng tái chế tự làm giảm lượng rác phát sinh.

paragraphs.label: Lựa chọn
paragraphs.text: For this situation, I would choose refillable water containers and reusable cups. The club meets in the same room every week, so these items could be kept there and used repeatedly instead of being replaced after each meeting.
paragraphs.noteVi: Liên hệ địa điểm cố định với khả năng dùng lại.

parts.text: For this situation, I would choose
parts.labelVi: Chọn một phương án + cụm danh từ

parts.text: refillable water containers and reusable cups. The club meets in the same room every week, so these items could be kept there and used repeatedly instead of being replaced after each meeting.

paragraphs.label: Hiệu quả và điều kiện
paragraphs.text: This would address the main source of rubbish directly. Members could refill their own bottles, and reusable cups would be available for anyone who forgot one. I would first check that there was a suitable supply of drinking water and a place to wash and store the cups. A simple cleaning rota would make the arrangement more reliable than expecting one volunteer to do everything.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua nước uống và vệ sinh.

parts.text: This would address the main source of rubbish directly. Members could refill their own bottles, and reusable cups would be available for anyone who forgot one. I would first check that there was a suitable supply of drinking water and a place to wash and store the cups. A simple cleaning rota would make the arrangement more reliable than expecting one volunteer to do everything.

paragraphs.label: Hai lựa chọn khác
paragraphs.text: Buying more recycling bins could improve sorting, but it would not stop the club using new disposable cups and bottles each week. Collection arrangements would also matter. Printing environmental posters might remind people to care about waste, but a poster alone does not give them a practical alternative when they are thirsty. The message could support the change, but it should not use most of the budget.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân biệt giảm phát sinh và xử lý sau phát sinh.

parts.text: Buying more recycling bins could improve sorting, but it would not stop the club using new disposable cups and bottles each week. Collection arrangements would also matter. The message could support the change, but it should not use most of the budget.

paragraphs.label: Chốt
paragraphs.text: Overall, I would invest in a small refill system first and explain how members should use it. We could compare the number of rubbish bags before and after a few meetings to see whether it was helping.
paragraphs.noteVi: Có cách đánh giá đơn giản.
